data.one_liner: A Flutter widget to detect swipe directions and provide callbacks for gestures.
data.what_it_does: A package that detects various swipe directions (up, down, left, right) and offers callbacks to handle them. It includes a widget wrapper that simplifies gesture detection on its child elements.
use_when: You need to detect directional swipes on specific widgets.
You want easy-to-use callbacks for up, down, left, and right swipes.
avoid_when: You require complex multi-touch gesture recognition beyond basic directional swipes.
strengths: Simple and straightforward API with specific direction callbacks.
Provides offset details and live feedback options.
weaknesses: Limited to basic directional swipe detection.

alternatives.name: simple_gesture_detector
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides similar gesture and swipe detection functionality.
